Error Message: The variable is under controlled terminology, but no codelist has been defined for it in the define.xml
Description: Variables that are under CT must have an associated codelist defined in the define.xml

Error Message: USUBJID is not found in DM.USUBJID
Description: Trigger error when domain is not an AP-- domain and USUBJID is not present in DM.USUBJID

Error Message: '--REPNUM is null or is not unique per subject per test per timing variables.
Description: Raise an error when REPNUM is in the dataset and there are multiple records for a subject for a test within the timeframe identified by the timing variables on the record, and --REPNUM is null or not unique per subject per test per timing variables.

Error Message: More than 1 study identifier is specified for the same organization.
Description: An identified organization is not expected to have more than 1 identifier for the study.

Error Message: The identifier text is not unique within the scope of the identified organization.
Description: Every identifier must be unique within the scope of an identified organization.

Error Message: The planned sex does includes more than a single entry of male and/or female either by duplications or unexpected codes.
Description: A planned sex must ether include a single entry of male or female or both female and male as entries.

Error Message: The observational study design's time perspective is not specified according to the extensible Observational Study Time Perspective (C127261) SDTM codelist - codeSystem is not "http://www.cdisc.org", codeSystemVersion is not a valid terminology package date, and/or the code or decode (either as preferred term or as submission value) is found in the codelist (case insensitive) but the corresponding decode or code does not match the codelist value (case sensitive).
Description: An observational study design's time perspective must be specified according to the extensible Observational Study Time Perspective (C127261) SDTM codelist (e.g. an entry with a code or decode used from the codelist should be consistent with the full entry in the codelist).

Error Message: The study design's observational model is not specified according to the extensible Observational Study Model (C127259) SDTM codelist - codeSystem is not "http://www.cdisc.org", codeSystemVersion is not a valid terminology package date, and/or the code or decode (either as preferred term or as submission value) is found in the codelist (case insensitive) but the corresponding decode or code does not match the codelist value (case sensitive).
Description: A study design's observational model must be specified according to the extensible Observational Study Model (C127259) SDTM codelist (e.g. an entry with a code or decode used from the codelist should be consistent with the full entry in the codelist).

Error Message: The study design's characteristic is not specified according to the extensible study design characteristics (C207416) DDF codelist - codeSystem is not "http://www.cdisc.org", codeSystemVersion is not a valid terminology package date, and/or the code or decode (either as preferred term or as submission value) is found in the codelist (case insensitive) but the corresponding decode or code does not match the codelist value (case sensitive).
Description: A study design's characteristics must be specified according to the extensible study design characteristics (C207416) DDF codelist (e.g. an entry with a code or decode used from the codelist should be consistent with the full entry in the codelist).

Error Message: The study design's blinding schema is not specified according to the extensible Trial Blinding Schema Response (C66735) SDTM codelist - codeSystem is not "http://www.cdisc.org", codeSystemVersion is not a valid terminology package date, and/or the code or decode (either as preferred term or as submission value) is found in the codelist (case insensitive) but the corresponding decode or code does not match the codelist value (case sensitive).
Description: A study design's blinding schema must be specified according to the extensible Trial Blinding Schema Response (C66735) SDTM codelist (e.g. an entry with a code or decode used from the codelist should be consistent with the full entry in the codelist).

Error Message: The study design's intervention model is not specified according to the extensible Intervention Model Response (C99076) SDTM codelist - codeSystem is not "http://www.cdisc.org", codeSystemVersion is not a valid terminology package date, and/or the code or decode (either as preferred term or as submission value) is found in the codelist (case insensitive) but the corresponding decode or code does not match the codelist value (case sensitive).
Description: A study design's intervention model must be specified according to the extensible Intervention Model Response (C99076) SDTM codelist (e.g. an entry with a code or decode used from the codelist should be consistent with the full entry in the codelist).

Error Message: The interventional study design's sub type is not specified according to the extensible Trial Type Response (C66739) SDTM codelist - codeSystem is not "http://www.cdisc.org", codeSystemVersion is not a valid terminology package date, and/or the code or decode (either as preferred term or as submission value) is found in the codelist (case insensitive) but the corresponding decode or code does not match the codelist value (case sensitive).
Description: An interventional study design's sub types must be specified according to the extensible Trial Type Response (C66739) SDTM codelist (e.g. an entry with a code or decode used from the codelist should be consistent with the full entry in the codelist).

Error Message: The administrable product is referenced both as the administrable product for an administration and as the embedded product of a medical device that is referenced by the same administration.
Description: An administrable product must not be referenced as both the administrable product for an administration and the embedded product of a medical device that is referenced by the same administration.

Error Message: There is not a one-to-one relationship between the referenced section number and title within the study definition document affected by the study amendment.
Description: There must be a one-to-one relationship between referenced section number and title within any study definition document affected by a study amendment.

Error Message: The study enrollment does not apply to either a geographic scope, a study site, or a study cohort - it does not apply to one and only one of these, or the value for forStudySiteId or forStudyCohortId is invalid.
Description: Each study enrollment must apply to either a geographic scope, a study site, or a study cohort.

Error Message: The study role references both at least one assigned person and at least one organization.
Description: A study role must not reference both assigned persons and organizations.

Error Message: The activity does not refer to any procedure, biomedical concept, biomedical concept category, biomedical concept surrogate, child activity, or timeline.
Description: An activity is expected to refer to at least one procedure, biomedical concept, biomedical concept category, biomedical concept surrogate, child activity, or timeline.

Error Message: The id value specified to indicate what the condition applies to does not reference a procedure, activity, biomedical concept, biomedical concept category, or biomedical concept surrogate - either the specified id is not an id for anything (it is invalid), or the instance identified by the id is not one of the expected classes.
Description: When a condition applies to a procedure, activity, biomedical concept, biomedical concept category, or biomedical concept surrogate then an instance must be available in the corresponding class with the specified id.

Error Message: The study element references a study intervention that is not defined within the same study design.
Description: A study element must only reference study interventions that are defined within the same study design as the study element.

Error Message: Expected variable with missing value for all records
Description: Expected variables may contain some null values, but in most cases will not contain null values for every record. When no data has been collected for an Expected variable, however, a null column must still be included in the dataset, and a comment must be included in the define.xml to state that data was not collected.

Error Message: The unit for the strength denominator is missing.
Description: If a strength denominator is specified, it must have a unit.

Error Message: The reference to the intervention is not targetting an intervention that has been referenced by the study design as a study intervention.
Description: A study element must only reference study interventions that are referenced by the same study design as the study element.

Error Message: The administration dose has been specified without a route or vice versa.
Description: If an administration's dose is specified then a corresponding route is expected and vice versa.

Error Message: The duration quantity is specified while the duration is indicated to vary or vice versa.
Description: If the duration will vary, a quantity is not expected for the duration and vice versa.

Error Message: The quantity and text are both missing for the specified duration.
Description: At least the text or the quantity must be specified for a duration.

Error Message: The referenced substance is referencing a substance.
Description: A reference substance must not have a reference substance.

Error Message: The study role is a sponsor role (code.code is C70793) but it does not point to exactly one organization - it does not have exactly one value for organizationIds that is a valid id value for an organization.
Description: The sponsor study role must point to exactly one organization.

Error Message: The reference to the intervention is not targetting an intervention that has been referenced by the study design as a study intervention.
Description: A procedure must only reference a study intervention that is referenced by the same study design as the activity within which the procedure is defined.

Error Message: A unit has been specified for a planned completion number
Description: A unit must not be specified for a planned completion number.

Error Message: A unit has been specified for a planned enrollment number
Description: A unit must not be specified for a planned enrollment number.

Error Message: The same characteristics code is used more than once within the study design.
Description: Within a study design, if more characteristics are defined, they must be distinct.

Error Message: The interventional study design's intent type is not specified according to the extensible Trial Intent Type Response (C66736) SDTM codelist - codeSystem is not "http://www.cdisc.org", codeSystemVersion is not a valid terminology package date, and/or the code or decode (either as preferred term or as submission value) is found in the codelist (case insensitive) but the corresponding decode or code does not match the codelist value (case sensitive).
Description: An interventional study design's intent types must be specified according to the extensible Trial Intent Type Response (C66736) SDTM codelist (e.g. an entry with a code or decode used from the codelist should be consistent with the full entry in the codelist).

Error Message: The administrable product's product designation is not specified using the product designation (C207418) DDF codelist - codeSystem is not "http://www.cdisc.org", codeSystemVersion is not a valid terminology package date, the code or decode (either as preferred term or as submission value) is found in the codelist (case insensitive) but the corresponding decode or code does not match the codelist value (case sensitive), and/or neither code nor decode is found in the codelist.
Description: An administrable product's product designation must be specified using the product designation (C207418) DDF codelist.

Error Message: The medical device sourcing is not specified according to the extensible medical device sourcing (C215482) DDF codelist - codeSystem is not "http://www.cdisc.org", codeSystemVersion is not a valid terminology package date, and/or the code or decode (either as preferred term or as submission value) is found in the codelist (case insensitive) but the corresponding decode or code does not match the codelist value (case sensitive).
Description: A medical device sourcing must be specified using the extensible medical device sourcing (C215482) DDF codelist (e.g. an entry with a code or decode used from the codelist should be consistent with the full entry in the codelist).

Error Message: The administrable product sourcing is not specified according to the extensible administrable product sourcing (C215483) DDF codelist - codeSystem is not "http://www.cdisc.org", codeSystemVersion is not a valid terminology package date, and/or the code or decode (either as preferred term or as submission value) is found in the codelist (case insensitive) but the corresponding decode or code does not match the codelist value (case sensitive).
Description: An administrable product sourcing must be specified using the extensible administrable product sourcing (C215483) DDF codelist (e.g. an entry with a code or decode used from the codelist should be consistent with the full entry in the codelist).

Error Message: The medical device identifier type is not specified according to the extensible medical device identifier type (C215484) DDF codelist - codeSystem is not "http://www.cdisc.org", codeSystemVersion is not a valid terminology package date, and/or the code or decode (either as preferred term or as submission value) is found in the codelist (case insensitive) but the corresponding decode or code does not match the codelist value (case sensitive).
Description: A medical device identifier type must be specified according to the extensible medical device identifier type (C215484) DDF codelist (e.g. an entry with a code or decode used from the codelist should be consistent with the full entry in the codelist).

Error Message: The study role is a sponsor role (code.code is C70793) but it is not applicable to the study version (appliesToIds does not contain the id of the study version).
Description: The sponsor study role must be applicable to a study version.

Error Message: There is not exactly one study role with a code of sponsor (where code.code is C70793).
Description: There must be exactly one study role with a code of sponsor.

Error Message: The organization type is not specified according to the extensible organization type (C188724) DDF codelist - codeSystem is not "http://www.cdisc.org", codeSystemVersion is not a valid terminology package date, and/or the code or decode (either as preferred term or as submission value) is found in the codelist (case insensitive) but the corresponding decode or code does not match the codelist value (case sensitive).
Description: An organization type must be specified according to the extensible organization type (C188724) DDF codelist (e.g. an entry with a code or decode used from the codelist should be consistent with the full entry in the codelist).

Error Message: All attributes of the address are blank.
Description: At least one attribute must be specified for an address.

Error Message: The study role does not only apply to the study version or at least one study design - it does not apply to anything, it applies to both the study version and at least one study design, or it applies to something that is not a study version or a study design.
Description: Every study role must apply to either a study version or at least one study design, but not both.

Error Message: The administration dose has been specified without an administrable product (either as a direct administrable product or as an embedded product via the related medical device) or vice versa.
Description: If a dose is specified, then a corresponding administrable product must also be specified either directly or embedded in the medical device and vice versa.

Error Message: There is more than one date of this type for the study definition document version, but at least one of the dates has a global geographic scope.
Description: Within a study definition document version, if a date of a specific type exists with a global geographic scope then no other dates are expected with the same type.

Error Message: The administration dose has been specified without a frequency.
Description: If a dose is specified then a corresponding frequency must also be specified.

Error Message: A section title is indicated to be displayed (displaySectionTitle=true) but not specified.
Description: If a section title is to be displayed then a title must be specified.

Error Message: A section number is indicated to be displayed (displaySectionNumber=true) but not specified.
Description: If a section number is to be displayed then a number must be specified.

Error Message: A planned enrollment number has been specified for both the study population and the cohorts, or it has been specified for only a subset of the cohorts.
Description: Within a study design, if a planned enrollment number is defined, it must be specified either in the study population or in all cohorts.

Error Message: A planned completion number has been specified for both the study population and one or more cohorts, or it has been specified for only a subset of the cohorts.
Description: Within a study design, if a planned completion number is defined, it must be specified either in the study population or in all cohorts.

Error Message: The order of the encounters in the study design (as defined by the next attribute) does not match the order of encounters as referenced from scheduled activity instances in the main timeline that are ordered by default condition.
Description: Encounter ordering using previous and next attributes is expected to be consistent with the order of corresponding scheduled activity instances according to their specified default conditions.

Error Message: The narrative content text contains non-conformant XHTML.
Description: Narrative content text is expected to be HTML formatted.

Error Message: Variable value for --DUR does not comply with ISO-8601-duration format
The geographic scope is global (type.code = C68846) and a code has been specified or the geographic scope is not global (type.code is not C68846) and no code has been specified.
Description: If a geographic scope type is global then no code is expected to specify the specific area within scope while if it is not global then a code is expected to specify the specific area within scope.

Error Message: Records are not unique as per sponsor defined key variables as documented in the define.xml
Description: Trigger error if records are not unique as per sponsor defined key variables as documented in the define.xml

Error Message: The treatment-emergent flag is missing.
Description: Treatment-emergent flag should be present in SUPPAE for each Adverse Event.

Error Message: The eligibility criterion is not referenced referenced by either the study design population or any of its cohorts.
Description: An eligibility criterion must be referenced by either a study design population or cohorts.

Error Message: The eligibility criterion item is used more than once within the study design.
Description: An eligibility criterion item must not be used more than once within a study design.

Error Message: The eligibility criterion item is not used in at least one study design.
Description: An eligibility criterion item is expected to be used in at least one study design.

Error Message: The study definition document version is not referenced by either a study version or a study design.
Description: Each study definition document version is expected to be referenced by either a study version or a study design.

Error Message: The study design is documented more than once by the same study definition document version.
Description: A study definition document version must not be referenced more than once by the same study design.

Error Message: The displayed section number is not unique within the study definition document version.
Description: Within a document version, the specified displayed section numbers for narrative content must be unique.

Error Message: The StudyArm does not have one StudyCell for each StudyEpoch.
Description: Each StudyArm is expected to have one StudyCell for each StudyEpoch.

Error Message: The reference to the indication is not targetting an indication that has been defined within the same study design.
Description: A study cohort must only reference indications that are defined within the same study design.

Error Message: The study design has more than one of the following characteristics: "Randomized", "Stratification", "Stratified Randomisation".
Description: A study design is not expected to have more than one of the following characteristics: "Randomized", "Stratification", "Stratified Randomisation".

Error Message: The study design is characterized as both "Single Country" and "Multiple Countries".
Description: A study design must not be characterized as both "Single Country" and "Multiple Countries".

Error Message: The study design is characterized as both "Single-Centre" and "Multicentre".
Description: A study design must not be characterized as both "Single-Centre" and "Multicentre".

Error Message: The therapeutic areas of the study design are not unique - the same code is used more than once within the same codeSystem and codeSystemVersion.
Description: Within a study design, if more therapeutic areas are defined, they must be distinct.

Error Message: The same intent types code is used more than once within the study design.
Description: Within a study design, if more intent types are defined, they must be distinct.

Error Message: The same sub types code is used more than once within the study design.
Description: Within a study design, if more sub types are defined, they must be distinct.

Error Message: The variable value is a list of values separated by a semicolon, and the variable is under controlled terminology, but not all values after splitting are in the controlled terminology list
The multiple specimens are not correctly separated by a semicolon
Description: If multiple specimen types are used for a calculation (e.g., serum and urine for creatinine clearance), then this field should be populated with values from the (SPEC) Controlled Terminology codelist delimited by a semicolon.

Error Message: The administrable dose form is not specified according to the extensible Pharmaceutical Dosage Form (C66726) SDTM codelist - codeSystem is not "http://www.cdisc.org", codeSystemVersion is not a valid terminology package date, and/or the code or decode (either as preferred term or as submission value) is found in the codelist (case insensitive) but the corresponding decode or code does not match the codelist value (case sensitive).
Description: An administrable dose form must be specified according to the extensible Pharmaceutical Dosage Form (C66726) SDTM codelist (e.g. an entry with a code or decode used from the codelist should be consistent with the full entry in the codelist).

Error Message: The study impact type is not specified according to the extensible study amendment impact type (C215481) DDF codelist - codeSystem is not "http://www.cdisc.org", codeSystemVersion is not a valid terminology package date, and/or the code or decode (either as preferred term or as submission value) is found in the codelist (case insensitive) but the corresponding decode or code does not match the codelist value (case sensitive).
Description: A study amendment impact type must be specified according to the extensible study amendment impact type (C215481) DDF codelist (e.g. an entry with a code or decode used from the codelist should be consistent with the full entry in the codelist).

Error Message: The reference identifier type is not specified according to the extensible reference identifier type (C215478) DDF codelist - codeSystem is not "http://www.cdisc.org", codeSystemVersion is not a valid terminology package date, and/or the code or decode (either as preferred term or as submission value) is found in the codelist (case insensitive) but the corresponding decode or code does not match the codelist value (case sensitive).
Description: A reference identifier type must be specified according to the extensible reference identifier type (C215478) DDF codelist  (e.g. an entry with a code or decode used from the codelist should be consistent with the full entry in the codelist).

Error Message: The administrable product property type is not specified according to the extensible administrable product property type (C215479) DDF codelist - codeSystem is not "http://www.cdisc.org", codeSystemVersion is not a valid terminology package date, and/or the code or decode (either as preferred term or as submission value) is found in the codelist (case insensitive) but the corresponding decode or code does not match the codelist value (case sensitive).
Description: An administrable product property type must be specified according to the extensible administrable product property type (C215479) DDF codelist (e.g. an entry with a code or decode used from the codelist should be consistent with the full entry in the codelist).

Error Message: The administration's route is not specified according to the extensible Route of Administration Response (C66729) SDTM codelist - codeSystem is not "http://www.cdisc.org", codeSystemVersion is not a valid terminology package date, and/or the code or decode (either as preferred term or as submission value) is found in the codelist (case insensitive) but the corresponding decode or code does not match the codelist value (case sensitive).
Description: An administration's route must be specified according to the extensible Route of Administration Response (C66729) SDTM codelist (e.g. an entry with a code or decode used from the codelist should be consistent with the full entry in the codelist).

Error Message: The administration's frequency is not specified according to the extensible Frequency (C71113) SDTM codelist - codeSystem is not "http://www.cdisc.org", codeSystemVersion is not a valid terminology package date, and/or the code or decode is found in the codelist (case insensitive) but the corresponding decode or code does not match the codelist value (case sensitive).
Description: An administration's frequency must be specified according to the extensible Frequency (C71113) SDTM codelist (e.g. an entry with a code or decode used from the codelist should be consistent with the full entry in the codelist).

Error Message: The activity has children but also refers to a timeline, procedure, biomedical concept, biomedical concept category, or biomedical concept surrogate as well.
Description: An activity with children must not refer to a timeline, procedure, biomedical concept, biomedical concept category or biomedical concept surrogate.

Error Message: Value for IDVAR in CO does not represent a variable present in the dataset referenced in RDOMAIN.
Description: Part C - Raise and error when IDVAR in CO is not populated with a valid variable from the dataset referenced in RDOMAIN.

Error Message: Value for IDVAR in RELREC does not represent a variable present in the dataset referenced in RDOMAIN.
Description: Part B - Raise and error when IDVAR in RELREC is not populated with a valid variable from the dataset referenced in RDOMAIN.

Error Message: Value for IDVAR in SUPP-- does not represent a variable present in the dataset referenced in RDOMAIN.
Description: Part A - Raise and error when IDVAR in SUPP-- is not populated with a valid variable from the dataset referenced in RDOMAIN.

Error Message: Variables not listed in the Model List of Allowed Variables for Observation Class should be in SUPPQUAL.
Description: Trigger error when variable is not an allowed variable for an Observation Class

Error Message: Variables not listed in the Model List of Allowed Variables for Observation Class should be in SUPPQUAL.
Description: Trigger error when variable is not an allowed variable for an Observation Class

Error Message: The previous/next ordering of the activity with respect to child activities is incorrect - the activity has children but its nextId is not one if its childIds, the activity is a child but its previousId is not its parent or another child, and/or the activity's previousId refers to an activity with children but the activity is not one of those children.
Description: The ordering of activities (using the previous and next attributes) must include the parents (e.g. activities referring to children) preceding their children.

Error Message: Issue with codelist definition in the Define-XML document.
Description: Testing rule type Variables Metadata Check against Define XML and Library Metadata

Error Message: The study version does not have exactly one sponsor study identifier.
Description: There must be exactly one sponsor study identifier (i.e., a study identifier whose scope is an organization that is identified as the organization for the sponsor study role).

Error Message: The number of study interventions referenced for the interventional study design is not consistent with intervention model specified for the study design - either the model indicates a single group (model.code is C82640) and there is not reference to only one study intervention, or the model does not indicate a single group (model.code is not C82640) and there are not references to multiple study interventions.
Description: If the intervention model indicates a single group design then only one intervention is expected. In all other cases more interventions are expected.

Error Message: The order of the epochs in the study design (as defined by the next attribute) does not match the order of epochs as referenced from scheduled activity instances in the main timeline that are ordered by default condition.
Description: Epoch ordering using previous and next attributes is expected to be consistent with the order of corresponding scheduled activity instances according to their specified default conditions.

Error Message: The study type is Interventional (code=C98388) but a study intervention is not referenced from any procedure.
Description: Within a study design, if study type is Interventional then at least one intervention is expected to be referenced from a procedure.

Error Message: '--STRESC is numeric but --STRESN is not populated or not equal to --STRESC.
Description: Raise an error when --STRESC is populated with a numeric value, but --STRESN is not populated, or --STRESN is not equal to --STRESC.
Standard Name: SENDIG, SENDIG-DART, SENDIG-GENETOX, TIG, SDTMIG, SENDIG-AR

Error Message: Variable type in dataset does not variable datatype in the define.xml
Description: Trigger error when variable type does not match IG Type (for domains in IG) or Model Type (custom domains)

Error Message: '--ENDTC is greater than RFPENDTC
Description: End Date/Time (--ENDTC) variable value must be less than or equal to Date/Time of End of Participation (RFPENDTC).

Error Message: The study definition document version's status is not specified using the status Value Set Terminology (C188723) DDF codelist - codeSystem is not "http://www.cdisc.org", codeSystemVersion is not a valid terminology package date, the code or decode (either as preferred term or as submission value) is found in the codelist (case insensitive) but the corresponding decode or code does not match the codelist value (case sensitive), and/or neither code nor decode is found in the codelist.
Description: A study definition document version's status must be specified using the status Value Set Terminology (C188723) DDF codelist.

Error Message: The scheduled activity/decision instance references an epoch that is not defined within the same study design.
Description: A scheduled activity/decision instance must only reference an epoch that is defined within the same study design as the scheduled activity/decision instance.

Error Message: The class relationship does not conform with the USDM schema.
Description: Class relationships must conform with the USDM schema based on the API specification.

Error Message: The combination of arm and epoch occurs more than once within the study design.
Description: Each combination of arm and epoch must occur no more than once within a study design.

Error Message: RDOMAIN has a missing value when IDVARVAL has a non-missing value.
Description: Raise an error when RDOMAIN is null when IDVARVAL is not null.

Error Message: The variable is not found in the underlying SDTM model for the same observation class
Description: Report a violation when the variable is not found in the underlying SDTM model for the same observation class

Error Message: RPHASE must be populated when one of the timing variables is populated
Description: Raise an error when one of the timing variables is populated and RPHASE is not populated

Error Message: The variable is not an allowed variable for the underlying Observation Class
Description: Trigger error when variable is not an allowed variable for the underlying Observation Class

Error Message: Multiple races are collected in SUPPDM but RACE in DM does not equal "MULTIPLE".
Description: Raise an error when multiple races are collected in SUPPDM but RACE in DM does not equal "MULTIPLE".

Error Message: Missing AESMIE=Y where SUPPAE.QNAM=AESOSP
Description: When SUPPAE.QNAM=AESOSP is present, a record with AESMIE=Y should be present

Error Message: Ethnicity(CETHNIC) has been collected as "Spanish origin" but the values in DM is not mapped to "HISPANIC OR LATINO"
Description: When Ethnicity (CETHNIC) "Spanish origin" was collected and was not mapped as "HISPANIC OR LATINO" in DM domain's RACE.

Error Message: Haitin or Negro was collected in CRACE but RACE does not have the value as BLACK OR AFRICAN AMERICAN
Description: "Haitian or Negro" was collected and was not mapped as "BLACK OR AFRICAN AMERICAN" in DM domain RACE.

Error Message: Ethnicity has been collected but the values is not mapped to "HISPANIC OR LATINO" or "NOT HISPANIC OR LATINO"
Description: When Ethnicity was collected and it was not mapped as "HISPANIC OR LATINO" or "NOT HISPANIC OR LATINO".

Error Message: IDVARVAL does not equal a value of the variable referenced by IDVAR in domain = RDOMAIN.
Description: When IDVAR is populated, IDVARVAL must equal a value of the variable referenced by IDVAR within the domain referenced by RDOMAIN

Error Message: An appropriate identifier is not present; USUBJID, APID, SPDEVID, SPTOBID, POOLID, SPTOBID, STOCONID should be present.
Description: APID is required in all Associated Persons Data. In addition to STUDYID, DOMAIN, and --SEQ being required for all domains based on one of the 3 general observation classes, one of USUBJID, APID, SPDEVID, or POOLID must also be present.

Error Message: Subject has a no record in EX but is assigned to a treatment while participating in an interventional study
Description: All subjects that have no record in the Exposure domain who are participating in a study that includes an interventional product should not be assigned to a treatment.

Error Message: The text attribute contains non-conformant XHTML.
Description: Syntax template text is expected to be HTML formatted.

Error Message: The reference to the narrative content item is not targetting a narrative content item that has been defined within the study.
Description: A piece of narrative content must only reference narrative content items that have been defined within the study.

Error Message: The study definition document type is not specified according to the extensible study definition document type (C215477) DDF codelist - codeSystem is not "http://www.cdisc.org", codeSystemVersion is not a valid terminology package date, and/or the code or decode (either as preferred term or as submission value) is found in the codelist (case insensitive) but the corresponding decode or code does not match the codelist value (case sensitive).

Description: Trigger error if the value of a variable, which is associated with an extensible codelist, is in the associated codelist or equal to 'OTHER'

Description: Trigger error when --TERM has been modified for coding and --MODIFY is null

Error Message: Deviation event must not be derived deviation

Error Message: ARMCD value length is greater than 20

Description: There should always be data presented in the --ORRES variable unless  --STAT = "NOT DONE".

Error Message: TSPARMCD = PLANSUB but the value provided in TSVAL is not a positive integer.
Description: Raise an error when TSPARMCD = "PLANSUB" and the value provided in TSVAL is not an integer greater than 0.

Error Message: TSPARMCD = FCNTRY but TSVCDREF is not equal to 'ISO 3166-1 alpha-3'
Description: Raise an error when TSPARMCD = FCNTRY and TSVCDREF is not equal to 'ISO 3166-1 alpha-3'

Error Message: TSPARMCD = ACTSUB but the value provided in TSVAL is not a positive integer.
Description: Raise an error when TSPARMCD = "ACTSUB" and the value provided in TSVAL is not an integer greater than 0.

Error Message: The filename is not equal to the 2-character domain code.
Description: Raise an error when the filename is not equal to the value of DOMAIN.

Error Message: The mass identification is not unique within the subject regardless of the mass location.
Description: Raise an error when the mass identification is not unique within the subject, regardless of the mass location.

Error Message: The Body Weight test is not unique for this subject and date/time.
Description: Raise an error when there is more than one record present for any particular Body Weight test, in the BW Domain, for a subject on a particular date.

Error Message: TSPARMCD = "RANDQT" but TSVAL is not a number between 0 and 1.
Description: Raise an error when TSPARMCD = "RANDQT" and the value provided in TSVAL is not a number between 0 and 1.

Error Message: The value of PYSTRESC is not one from the codelist PYFINDRS for PYTESTCD 'PREGSTAT'
Description: Raise an error when the value of PYTESTCD = PREGSTAT and the value of PYSTRESC is not one of the codelist PYFINDRS

Error Message: The value of FETUSID is not unique within USUBJID
Description: Raise an error when the combination of USUBJID and FETUSID in not unique

Error Message: Variable is missing, where variable core status is permissible and data is planned to be collected.
Description: Raise an error when variable Core Status = Permissible and data is planned to be collected, but variable is not present

Error Message: MBRESCAT is expected when MBTESTCD='ORGANISM', MSSTRESC!='NO GROWTH', MBMETHOD!='GRAM STAIN'
Description: Raise an error when MBTESTCD=ORGANISM, MSSTRESC!='NO GROWTH', MBMETHOD!='GRAM STAIN' and MBRESCAT is empty

Description: The value of -NOMDY must be an integer

Description: ACTARMCD values in Demographics are restricted to ARMCD values in Trial Arms when ACTARMCD is not equal to "SCRNFAIL", "NOTASSGN", "NOTTRT", or "UNPLAN"

Error Message: CMTRT was not collected on CRF
Description: Trigger error if CMTRT was not collected on CRF

Description: Verify that When USUBJID is populated, POOLID is not populated

Error Message: Variable AEDECOD is not present in ADVERSE EVENT dataset
Description: Variable AEDECOD should be present in analysis dataset for Adverse Event analysis

Error Message: Missing value for --DTC, when --ENDTC is provided
Description: Date/Time of Collection (--DTC) should not be NULL, when End Date/Time of Observation (--ENDTC) is not NULL.

Error Message: Value for --STNRHI is less than value for --STNRLO
Description: Reference Range Upper Limit-Std Units (--STNRHI) value must be greater than or equal to Reference Range Lower Limit-Std Units (--STNRLO) value.

Error Message: Missing value for --STTPT, when --STRTPT is populated
Description: Start Reference Time Point (--STTPT) must not be NULL, when Start Relative to Reference Time Point (--STRTPT) is provided.

Error Message: Missing value for --ENTPT, when --ENRTPT is populated
Description: End Reference Time Point (--ENTPT) must not be NULL, when End Relative to Reference Time Point (--ENRTPT) is provided.

Error Message: RFSTDTC is not provided for a randomized subject
Description: Subject Reference Start Date/Time (RFSTDTC) should be populated for all randomized subjects, those where Planned Arm Code (ARMCD) is not equal to 'SCRNFAIL' or 'NOTASSGN' or null.

Error Message: Inconsistent value for ARMCD
Description: A value for Planned Arm Code (ARMCD) must have a unique value for Description of Planned Arm (ARM) with the domain.

Error Message: Inconsistent value for --TESTCD within --TEST
Description: All values of Short Name of Measurement, Test or Examination (--TESTCD) should be the same for a given value of Name of Measurement, Test or (--TEST).

Error Message: Non-unique value for ETCD within ELEMENT
Description: Element Code (ETCD) must have a unique value for a given value of Description of Element (ELEMENT) within the domain.

Error Message: Duplicate ETCD value
Description: The value of Element Code (ETCD) variable must be unique within Trial Elements (TE) domain.

Error Message: Duplicate ELEMENT value
Description: The value of Element (Description of Element) variable must be unique within Trial Elements (TE) domain.

Description: All values of a Parameter (--PARM) variables should be the same for a given value of a Parameter Short Name (--PARMCD) variables.

Error Message: Inconsistent value for --PARMCD within --PARM
Description: All values of a Parameter Short Name (--PARMCD) variables should be the same for a given value of a Parameter (--PARM) variables.

Description: Age Range (AGETXT) variable values should be populated with 'number-number' format.

Error Message: Both AGE and AGETXT variables values are populated
Description: Age (AGE) and Age Range (AGETXT) variables should never both be populated for the same subject.

Error Message: AGE is not provided
Description: Age (AGE) variable values should be provided, when Date/Time of Birth (BRTHDTC) variable values are populated.

Description: Value for the Null Flavor (TSVALNF) variable must be populated using terms found in ISO 21090.

Description: Standardized Result in Numeric Format (--STRESN) variable value should be populated, when Standardized Result in Character Format (--STRESC) variable value represents a numeric value.

Error Message: Missing NCOHORT Trial Summary Parameter
Description: 'Number of Groups/Cohorts' (NCOHORT) record must be populated in Trial Summary (TS) domain. It is an 'FDA Desired' parameter listed in the Technical Conformance Guide (TCG).

Error Message: Missing OBJSEC Trial Summary Parameter
Description: 'Trial Secondary Objective' (OBJSEC) record must be populated in Trial Summary (TS) domain. It is an 'FDA Desired' parameter listed in the Technical Conformance Guide (TCG).

Error Message: Missing PDPSTIND Trial Summary Parameter
Description: 'Pediatric Postmarket Study Indicator' (PDPSTIND) record must be populated in Trial Summary (TS) domain. It is an 'FDA Desired' parameter listed in the Technical Conformance Guide (TCG).

Error Message: Missing PIPIND Trial Summary Parameter
Description: 'Pediatric Investigation Plan Indicator' (PIPIND) record must be populated in Trial Summary (TS) domain. It is an 'FDA Desired' parameter listed in the Technical Conformance Guide (TCG).

Error Message: Missing THERAREA Trial Summary Parameter
Description: 'Therapeutic Area' (THERAREA) record must be populated in Trial Summary (TS) domain. It is an 'FDA Desired' parameter listed in the Technical Conformance Guide (TCG).

Error Message: The Identfier variable in the define.xml is not found in the SDTM model
Description: Raise an error when variable role is 'Identifier', but the variable is not found in the SDTM model correspond to the role in the IG

Error Message: EXMETHOD is not to be used with human clinical trials
Description: Trigger error when EXMETHOD exists in the EX dataset for human clinical trials

Error Message: The define.xml does not contain an explanation of EXDOSE values with respect for intended or actual dose levels
Description: Raise a message when the define.xml does not contain an explanation of EXDOSE values with respect for intended or actual dose levels, using a reference to a def:CommentDef

Error Message: SEENDTC value of last element in SE is not equal to DSSTDTC in DS for the subject
Description: Because there are no time gaps between Elements, the SEENDTC value for the last Element is the date of subject disposition.

Description: '--VAL for ENVTEMPU record is the unit for the environmental temperature.  Only values of 'C' or 'F' are acceptable.

Error Message: Missing value for --EXCLFL, when --REASEX is provided
Description: Exclude from Statistics (--EXCLFL) should be set to 'Y', when Reason for Exclusion from Statistics (--REASEX) is populated.

Error Message: EXLOT is null, when EXDOSE is provided
Description: If Name of Actual Treatment (EXTRT) is administered, (i.e., Dose per Administration (EXDOSE) is greater than zero), then Lot Number (EXLOT) should also be provided.

Error Message: EXLOT is populated, when EXDOSE equals 0 or is NULL
Description: If Name of Actual Treatment (EXTRT) is not administered, (i.e., Dose per Administration (EXDOSE) is equal to zero or is not provided), then Lot Number  (EXLOT) should be null.

Error Message: SEENDTC is after the latest Disposition date
Description: End Date/Time of Element (SEENDTC) should be less than or equal to the Start Date/Time of the latest Disposition Event (DSSTDTC).

Error Message: Missing value for --STRESU, when --LLOQ is provided
Description: Lower Limit of Quantitation (--LLOQ) should be presented using the same units as those presented in Standard Units (--STRESU). When --LLOQ is provided, --STRESU should also be populated.

Error Message: Invalid value for --DTHREL
Description: Relationship to Death (--DTHREL) describes the relationship of a particular finding to the death of a subject. Allowed values for this variable include: 'Y' (Caused death), 'N' (Did not cause death), or 'U' (Unknown).

Error Message: Non-unique value for TXSEQ variable within TX domain
Description: Sequence Number (TXSEQ) should be unique within the entire Trial Sets (TX) dataset because there is no Unique Subject Identifier (USUBJID) variable.

Error Message: SETCD value not present in DM
Description: Set Code (SETCD) values defined in Trial Sets (TX) should be assigned to at least one subject (USUBJID) in Demographics (DM).

Error Message: Invalid --VAL value for AGE
Description: TSVAL/TXVAL must be numeric when TSPARMCD/TXPARMCD = 'AGE'.

Error Message: Invalid --VAL value for RECSAC
Description: TSVAL/TXVAL value must be either ISO 8601 format for time period (e.g. P80Y) or null, when TSPARMCD/TXPARMCD='RECSAC'.

Error Message: Invalid --VAL value for TRMSAC
Description: TSVAL/TXVAL value must be either ISO 8601 format for time period (e.g. P80Y) or null, when TSPARMCD/TXPARMCD='TRMSAC'.

Error Message: Invalid --VAL value for INTSAC
Description: TSVAL/TXVAL value must be either ISO 8601 format for time period (e.g. P80Y) or null, when TSPARMCD/TXPARMCD='INTSAC'.

Error Message: Invalid --VAL value for DOSDUR
Description: TSVAL/TXVAL value must be either ISO 8601 format for time period (e.g. P80Y) or null, when TSPARMCD/TXPARMCD='DOSDUR'.

Error Message: Invalid --VAL value for EXPENDTC
Description: TSVAL/TXVAL variable value must be in ISO 8601 format, when TSPARMCD/TXPARMCD = 'EXPENDTC'.

Error Message: Invalid --VAL value for EXPSTDTC
Description: TSVAL/TXVAL variable value must be in ISO 8601 format, when TSPARMCD/TXPARMCD = 'EXPSTDTC'.

Error Message: Invalid TSVAL value for SNDIGVER
Description: TSVAL for SNDIGVER record must be a valid term from (SNDIGVER) CT codelist.

Error Message: Invalid --VAL value for DOSSTDTC
Description: TSVAL/TXVAL variable value must be in ISO 8601 format, when TSPARMCD/TXPARMCD='DOSSTDTC'.

Error Message: Invalid --VAL value for DOSENDTC
Description: TSVAL/TXVAL variable value must be in ISO 8601 format, when TSPARMCD/TXPARMCD='DOSENDTC'.

Error Message: Missing TRTUNII Trial Summary Parameter
Description: 'Primary Treatment Unique Ingredient ID' (TRTUNII) record must be populated in Trial Summary (TS) domain.

Error Message: Missing SEXPOP Trial Summary Parameter
Description: 'Sex of Participants' (SEXPOP) record must be populated in Trial Summary (TS) domain.

Error Message: Missing PDOSFRQ Trial Summary Parameter
Description: 'Planned Dose Frequency' (PDOSFRQ) record should be populated in Trial Summary (TS) domain.

Error Message: Missing PCLASS Trial Summary Parameter
Description: 'Pharmacologic Class' (PCLASS) record should be populated in Trial Summary (TS) domain.

Error Message: Missing GLPFL Trial Summary Parameter
Description: 'Good Laboratory Practice Flag' (GLPFL) record should be populated in Trial Summary (TS) domain.

Error Message: Missing DOSSTDTC Trial Summary Parameter
Description: 'Start Date/Time of Dose Interval' (DOSSTDTC) record should be populated in Trial Summary (TS) domain.

Error Message: Missing DOSENDTC Trial Summary Parameter
Description: 'End Date/Time of Dose Interval' (DOSENDTC) record should be populated in Trial Summary (TS) domain.

Error Message: Missing STENDTC Trial Summary Parameter
Description: 'Study End Date' (STENDTC) record should be populated in Trial Summary (TS) domain.

Error Message: Missing SPLANSUB Trial Summary Parameter
Description: 'Planned Number of Subjects' (SPLANSUB) record should be populated in Trial Summary (TS) domain. It is used for Janus Non Clinical data load blocking.

Error Message: Invalid TSVAL value for STENDTC
Description: TSVAL variable value must be in ISO 8601 format, when TSPARMCD='STENDTC'.

Error Message: Invalid TSVAL value for STSTDTC
Description: TSVAL variable value must be in ISO 8601 format, when TSPARMCD='STSTDTC'.

Error Message: Invalid --VAL value for PLANMSUB
Description: TSVAL/TXVAL must be numeric when TSPARMCD/TXPARMCD = 'PLANMSUB'.

Error Message: Invalid --VAL value for PLANFSUB
Description: TSVAL/TXVAL must be numeric when TSPARMCD/TXPARMCD = 'PLANFSUB'.

Error Message: Invalid --VAL value for SPLANSUB
Description: TSVAL/TXVAL must be numeric when TSPARMCD/TXPARMCD = 'SPLANSUB'.

Error Message: Missing SLENGTH Trial Summary Parameter
Description: 'Study Length' (SLENGTH) record should be populated in Trial Summary (TS) domain. It is used for Janus Non Clinical data load blocking.

Error Message: Invalid --VAL value for SLENGTH
Description: TSVAL/TXVAL value must be either ISO 8601 format for time period (e.g. P80Y) or null, when TSPARMCD/TXPARMCD='SLENGTH'.

Error Message: No baseline flag record in Domain for subject
Description: All subjects should have at least one baseline observation (--BLFL = 'Y') in EG, LB, and VS domains.

Error Message: Missing values for all required set(s) of timing variables: VISITDY or --NOMDY
Description: At least one of these variables or sets of variables must be present and populated in PP: VISITDY or PPNOMDY. These are the required timing variables for identification of the day on which group summaries (Group Means and Incidences) are calculated for pharmacokinetic parameters.

Error Message: Duplicate TXPARMCD within a SETCD
Description: The value of Parameter Code (TXPARMCD) variable must be unique for each Trial Set (SETCD) within the Trial Sets (TX) domain.

Error Message: No Trial Set with TCNTRL Parameter
Description: 'Control Type' (TCNTRL) record should be populated in Trial Sets (TX) domain.   (There must be a record with TXPARMCD = TCNTRL within a set if the study has a control).

Error Message: Invalid POOLID
Description: Pool ID (POOLID) values should match entries in the Pool Definition (POOLDEF) dataset.

Error Message: Invalid SETCD
Description: Set Code (SETCD) values should match entries in the Trial Sets (TX) dataset.

Error Message: Value for --STRESC is populated, when --STAT is 'NOT DONE'
Description: Status (--STAT) should be NULL, when Standardized Result in Character Format (--STRESC ) is provided.

Error Message: Missing values for required timing variables: (VISITDY and --ELTM) or (--NOMDY and --ELTM)
Description: PCNOMDY and PCELTM or VISITDY and PCELTM must be present and populated in PC.   These are the required timing variables for identification of the day on which group summaries (Group Means and Incidences) are calculated for pharmacokinetic concentrations.

Error Message: Missing values for all required timing variables: --DY & --ENDY
Description: These variables must be populated:  --DY and --ENDY.  These are the required timing variables for identification of the day on which group summaries (Group Means and Incidences) are calculated for data associated with a time interval.

Error Message: Missing values for all required set(s) of timing variables:  VISITDY, --DY or --NOMDY
Description: At least one of the these variables or sets of variables should be populated: VISITDY, --DY, or --NOMDY. These are the Required timing variables for identification of the day on which group summaries (Group Means and Incidences) are calculated.

Error Message: Missing values for all required set(s) of timing variables: VISITDY, --STDY, or --NOMDY
Description: At least one of these variables or sets of variables must be present and populated in DS: (VISITDY, DSSTDY, or DSNOMDY)  These are the required timing variables for identification of the day on which group summaries (Group Means and Incidences) are calculated for post mortem data.

Error Message: Missing TRTDOSU Trial Set Parameter within SETCD
Description: 'Dose Units' (TRTDOSU) records should be populated for each SETCD in Trial Sets (TX) domain.

Error Message: Missing TRTDOS Trial Set Parameter within SETCD
Description: 'Dose Level' (TRTDOS) records should be populated for each SETCD in Trial Sets (TX) domain.

Error Message: Missing GRPLBL Trial Set Parameter within SETCD
Description: 'Group Label' (GRPLBL) records should be populated for each SETCD in Trial Sets (TX) domain.

Error Message: Missing SPGRPCD Trial Set Parameter within SETCD
Description: 'Sponsor-Defined Group Code' (SPGRPCD) records should be populated for each SETCD in Trial Sets (TX) domain.

Error Message: Missing ARMCD Trial Set Parameter within SETCD
Description: 'Arm Code' (ARMCD) records should be populated for each SETCD in Trial Sets (TX) domain.

Error Message: Duplicate USUBJID within a POOLID
Description: There should be only one record per subject (USUBJID) within Pool Identifier (POOLID) in the Pool Definition (POOLDEF) domain.

Error Message: Missing values for required timing variables: --NOMDY, --ELTM, and --TPTREF
Description: For PC records contributing to a time concentration profile, PCNOMDY, PCELTM and PCTPTREF must be present and populated. These are the required timing variables for identification of the day on which group summaries (Group Means and Incidences) are calculated for pharmacokinetic concentrations.

Error Message: PCELTM is not 'PT0H' for pre-dose sampling
Description: Specimen concentrations (e.g., plasma) used to calculate a time concentration profile with a pre-dose sample should have Planned Elapsed Time from Time Point Ref (PCELTM) populated with 'PT0H'. A negative elapsed time would lead to an incorrect area under the curve.

Error Message: Duplicate value for PCTPTREF for the same USUBJID (or POOLID) when PCNOMDY value is different
Description: Time Point Reference (PCTPTREF) must identify a unique dose. Ambiguous references such as 'Most recent dose' should be avoided; it is recommended that Time Point Reference (PCTPTREF) include both the Nominal Study Day for Tabulations (PCNOMDY) and the time point description in order (e.g., “Day 1, Dose 1” and “Day 1, Dose 2” for twice daily dosing).

Error Message: Missing value for PCLLOQ when PCSTRESC is 'BLQ' or 'BQL'
Description: When a measurement is identified as being below a limit of quantification threshold in Standardized Result in Character Format (PCSTRESC), Lower Limit of Quantitation (PCLLOQ) should be populated.

Error Message: Variable length exceeds 200 characters
Description: Due to SAS v5 transport file limitations, variables cannot have a length that is greater than 200 characters.  For SEND data, this results in loading errors into regulatory nonclinical review tools. The SENDIG should be followed in how to split long character strings appropriately.

Error Message: '--DTC does not equal DSSTDTC
Description: Date/Time of Collection (--DTC) variable value must be equal to Start Date/Time of latest Disposition (DSSTDTC) for post-mortem findings in the Macroscopic Findings (MA), Microscopic Findings (MI), and Tumor Findings (TF) domains.

Error Message: Multiple STDIR records
Description: Trial Summary (TS) domain must contain only one record for the 'STDIR' parameter.

Error Message: Multiple SSTYP records
Description: Trial Summary (TS) domain must contain only one record for the 'SSTYP' parameter.

Error Message: Multiple STCAT records
Description: Trial Summary (TS) domain must contain only one record for the 'STCAT' parameter.

Error Message: Multiple SDESIGN records
Description: Trial Summary (TS) domain must contain only one record for the 'SDESIGN' parameter.

Error Message: '--DY value when BWTESTCD = 'TERMBW' does not equal DSSTDY value
Description: For terminal body weight measurements (BWTESTCD/BWTEST = 'TERMBW'/'Terminal Body Weight'), the Study Day Animal Weighed (BWDY) variable value should be the same as the Study Day of Disposition (DSSTDY) variable value in the Disposition (DS) domain.

Error Message: '--DY value does not equal DSSTDY value
Description: For a specimen collected or observed post mortem, the Study Day (--DY) variable value should be the same as the Study Day of Disposition (DSSTDY) variable value in the Disposition (DS) domain.

Error Message: Unscheduled flag is populated for scheduled death
Description: For subjects that have a disposition status in the Disposition (DS) domain that indicates a scheduled death, the Unscheduled Flag (DSUSCHFL) should not be populated. Standardized Disposition Term (DSDECOD) values for scheduled death include: INTERIM SACRIFICE, TERMINAL SACRIFICE, RECOVERY SACRIFICE, and REMOVED FROM STUDY ALIVE.

Error Message: No record in DD domain for unscheduled death
Description: For subjects that have a disposition status in the Disposition (DS) domain that indicates an unscheduled death, the cause of death should be captured in the Death Diagnosis and Details (DD) domain. Standardized Disposition Term (DSDECOD) values for unscheduled death include: ACCIDENTAL DEATH, FOUND DEAD, MISSING, MORIBUND SACRIFICE, or NON-MORIBUND SACRIFICE. For SEND v3.1 and later, Unscheduled Flag (DSUSCHFL) should also be set to 'Y'.

Error Message: Missing STRPSTAT Trial Summary Parameter
Description: 'Study Report Status' (STRPSTAT) record should be populated in Trial Summary (TS) domain.

Error Message: Negative value for --STRESN when --EXCLFL is not populated
Description: The value of Standardized Result in Numeric Format (--STRESN) cannot be less than 0 when the record is not excluded from analysis, i.e., Exclude from Statistics (--EXCLFL) is not 'Y'. This applies for the following domains in SEND: BW, FM, FW, LB, OM, PC, PY, RE, VS.

Error Message: '--DTC is before the latest Disposition date
